outcomes.runtimeComparisonMeaning: Conservative range through last observed matching source timestamp or verified actual end; inspect every sampled capture/unavailable gap. Independent outcome continues after source change without runtime-performance credit.

limitations: Independent from POE selection but biased by current index coverage, volume-ranked pages, provisional indexed age and fixed cohort selection.
Quiet controls are selected before outcomes; they are not proven losing tokens. Unknown indexed metrics are retained but not invented for ranking.
Index createdAt, liquidity, volumes and prices are provider claims; strict migration/support proof and actual-size entry/exit evidence remain necessary.
No whole-market denominator, winner recall, trade qualification, execution or profit is established.

Late-retrieved OHLC is available at retrieval, never earlier. Runtime intersection uses sampled original public snapshots, not continuous coverage or an invented runtime end. Frozen-cohort outcomes may extend beyond a source change without runtime-performance credit.
Body bytes are measured; TLS/wire overhead and existing infrastructure/transfer cost remain unverified. No new API purchase or paid entitlement.

runtimeCoverage.meaning: Hash-bound sampled public facts, not proof of continuous market capture. Changed identity/stopped source never reopens this binding. Missing/stale snapshots and capture gaps remain in observation file; no runtime end invented.
